title: Register the Forge app and set the deploy secrets
what: forge login, forge register in the repo root (real app id into manifest.yml via a PR), add FORGE_EMAIL and FORGE_API_TOKEN repository secrets, install on the shared development site.
done: The deploy workflow deploys main to development; the Precedent panel renders on a work item on the shared site.

title: Provision a Forge demo site with Rovo for each teammate
what: Each person runs forge site provision and confirms Rovo Chat opens. Record the four site URLs in the team chat.
done: Four working demo sites with Rovo; one shared development site.

title: Create the Devpost team and register all four members
what: Create the team on codegeist2026.devpost.com and add everyone.
done: All four appear on the Devpost team page.

title: Review and accept spec 0001: decision model, lifecycle and approval authority
what: Agree the state table, per-scope approvers (finding 2) and identical-scope supersession (finding 5).
done: Spec merged with status Accepted; open questions have an owner and a date.

title: Review and accept spec 0002: core service contract
what: Agree src/core/contract.ts. After this it is frozen; changes go through a spec PR.
done: Spec merged with status Accepted; contract.ts matches it.

title: Review and accept spec 0003: capture pipeline
what: Agree the pre-filter patterns, the extraction schema and the capture threshold.
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0004: guard, rule checkers, freshness and coverage
what: Agree the freshness key (finding 1), the rule-checker table (finding 6) and the coverage rule (finding 7).
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0005: enforcement and conflict resolution
what: Agree validator modes, the viewer-safe message (finding 3) and Follow semantics (finding 4).
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0006: agents, MCP tools, rules export and skill
what: Agree the actions, publication approval for exports (finding 3) and the judged demo path (finding 9).
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0007: permissions, security and cost controls
what: Agree the permission model on every surface and the cost controls.
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0008: UI
what: Agree the conflict card and every state of the panel, badge, ledger and setup page.
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0009: AI pipeline and evaluation
what: Agree the prompts' rules, thresholds and the tuning/holdout split (finding 8).
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Review and accept spec 0010: sample workspace, demo and submission
what: Agree the seeded data, the video script and the submission checklist.
done: Spec merged with status Accepted.

title: Spike: install from a production share link on a second site as a non-contributor
what: Deploy to production, create the share link, install on another site as a user who is not an app contributor.
done: The panel renders on the second site. Steps and hesitations recorded in the issue.

title: Spike: triggers reach the queue consumers
what: avi:jira:commented:issue and avi:jira:updated:issue fire on the second site and reach the consumers. Record trigger, consumer and validator time limits.
done: Both events logged by a consumer on the second site; limits written into spec 0004.

title: Spike: Forge LLM extraction call returns valid JSON
what: One extraction prompt from a consumer through the llm module. Record latency, tokens and credit cost.
done: Valid JSON from the model; cost per call written into spec 0009; daily cap proposed.

title: Spike: the workflow validator blocks a transition with our message
what: Add the function validator to a transition on the demo site; return result false with a message. Check whether the app can detect validator usage.
done: Transition blocked with our message; detection answer written into spec 0005.

title: Spike: one action callable from the Rovo agent and from a Rovo Studio agent via rovo:mcp
what: get-decisions returns a fixed list from both paths. Record the tool names the MCP server exposes and the app.rovo metadata fields.
done: Both calls succeed on the second site; tool names and metadata fields written into spec 0006 and SKILL.md.

title: Spike: an action reads a work item as the invoking user
what: Inside an action (Rovo and MCP), read a work item as the user; a user without access gets a denial.
done: Allowed and denied cases both observed; fallback decided if MCP has no user context.

title: Spike: confirm the scopes the sample workspace needs
what: Create a project with components from the app on a demo site; find the minimum scopes (manage:jira-project?).
done: Scopes added to manifest.yml before any shared install.

title: Core service: storage entities, ScopeIndex and the decision lifecycle
what: recordDecision, confirmDecision with per-scope approvers, supersedeDecision with identical scope, audit log, revision bumps.
done: Ledger entries in test/lifecycle.test.ts converted to plain tests.

title: Guard pipeline: freshness key, sequence numbers and coverage
what: Triggers compute the freshness key and queue jobs; consumers write only the latest sequence; getIssueState reports stale and coverage.
done: Finding 1 acceptance test passes: accepting a conflicting rule or adding a component makes an unchanged ok stale and the recheck blocks.

title: Capture: comment pre-filter, extraction and quote check
what: Pre-filter, capture consumer, schema validation, quote-is-substring, threshold, dedupe.
done: test/capture.test.ts ledger entry is a plain test; capture end to end works on the shared site.

title: Rule checkers for the four typed kinds with evidence
what: tech_choice, data_policy, api_convention, process_rule on text and diffs; evidence on every conflict; inconclusive when intent or data flow is unclear.
done: Finding 6 fixtures: adding a banned dependency blocks, removing it does not, ambiguous prose is not a conflict; logging outside analysis surfaces the coverage limit.

title: Model judge for free-text decisions with batching
what: Judge prompt, schema, both-quotes check, threshold, batches of ≤10 within budget, inconclusive on failure or cap.
done: Finding 7 test passes: eleven rules with a violation in the eleventh never give ok.

title: Issue panel, conflict card and badge on a mock core
what: Every panel state from spec 0008, the conflict card, the Record decision form, the proposals list with Confirm for approvers, and the badge.
done: Each state renders from a mock core; wired to the real core, the refund work item shows a rule conflict with both quotes and evidence.

title: Decision ledger page
what: Filters, table, decision view with evidence and history, actions, Needs an owner list, empty state.
done: A judge can find any decision, see why it exists and how each conflict was resolved.

title: Evaluation: first 60 tuning cases
what: Sanitized fixtures across every group in eval/fixtures/tuning; eval/run.ts scores them.
done: bun run eval -- --set tuning prints precision, recall and the three counts.

title: Workflow validator with viewer-safe messages and Follow semantics
what: Validator per spec 0005: fresh check at transition time, lenient/strict, fail-open/closed, message rendered for the viewer; Follow keeps the conflict open until a recheck clears it.
done: test/enforcement.test.ts ledger entries are plain tests; finding 4 acceptance test passes on the shared site.

title: Permission-aware reads on every surface
what: canReadSource and filterVisible with cache, used by core for panel, ledger, Rovo, MCP, validator and export.
done: A restricted user sees no decision text on any surface; test/permissions.test.ts entries are plain tests.

title: Rovo agent and actions
what: Five action handlers on the real core; the Precedent agent with its prompt and conversation starters.
done: A new joiner's why question gets a cited answer; no decision covering the question gets an offer to record one.

title: rovo:mcp tools on a fresh install
what: get_decisions, check_proposal (advisory), record_decision, export_agent_rules through rovo:mcp; app.rovo metadata.
done: A Rovo Studio agent calls get_decisions on a fresh install; a redeploy with app.rovo metadata succeeds.

title: Agent rules export with per-repository publication approval, and SKILL.md
what: Renderer for agents_md and rovodev_review between the markers; Publish to repository on the ledger; withheldCount; finalise skills/precedent/SKILL.md tool names.
done: Finding 3 acceptance test passes: an unapproved rule stays out of the export; the restricted user sees no rule text.

title: Sample workspace: Northwind Payments seed and reset
what: Idempotent seed of NWP with the work items, comments and restricted item in spec 0010; capture runs on the seeded comments.
done: test/seed.test.ts entry is a plain test; one click on a fresh site gives four proposed decisions.

title: Setup page: health checks, approvers, scope mapping, guard settings, usage, guides
what: Every block in spec 0008's setup page, including the three guides.
done: A judge can go from install to a blocked transition using only the setup page.

title: Evaluation: 100+ cases with a frozen holdout set
what: Complete tuning (72) and holdout (46) sets; freeze thresholds; seal holdout with holdout.sha256.
done: Finding 8 acceptance test: no holdout case used for tuning; published counts reproduce from the frozen fixtures.

title: Security and cost reviews with the Forge developer skills
what: Run forge-security-review, forge-app-review and forge-cost-optimizer; fix findings; run forge eligibility.
done: Findings summarised in the README; SECURITY.md checklist ticked; Runs on Atlassian confirmed.

title: Fresh-install test as a non-contributor
what: Run the judge journey on a second site from the production share link, including the finding 9 checks (configured block, pending-check behaviour, Rovo Studio agent).
done: Every step passes; each hesitation became a line in JUDGE_TESTING.md or a fix.

title: Every UI state built and checked
what: Empty, checking, following, restricted, inconclusive, coverage gap and error states on every screen, light and dark.
done: Screenshot of every state attached to this issue.

title: Record and publish the demo video
what: Record after the fresh-install test, on production, following the script; narration matches what is shown.
done: Public YouTube link under 5:00; DEMO.md checklist ticked.

title: Devpost submission: description, technology, bonus write-ups, judge instructions
what: All text fields, the install link, category, both bonus write-ups naming rovo:mcp, rovo:agent, action and the skill, and honest limits.
done: Submitted on 20 Dec IST; confirmation email received.

title: README with measured numbers and release v1.0.0-codegeist
what: README evaluation section from the holdout report, security and cost review summaries, limits; tag the release that production runs.
done: Tag pushed; production deploy from the tag; README verified on a clean machine.
